DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0-: Your place here... is noisy. But you have many things. I'll take a look while I wait.
But of course! In this tedious wait, go ahead and pick any forgotten gem you like!
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.1-: Still waiting, are you? No rush on my end — take your time picking through that pile. You can afford to wait, and so can I!
DARV.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2-: I have countless gems here, but I don't seem to see the one you're waiting for...

If you truly have the one I seek... it need not shine. It only needs to appear when the time is right.
[i][font_size=22]Godot simply stands there, like a nail worn blunt by time.[/font_size][/i]
...Forget it. Save your choice for next time. It seems you're accustomed to waiting a very long time for "next time."
NEOW.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0-: You've pulled me up from silence again... This time, where shall I go to wait?
NEOW.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2-: If you would grant me something... grant me the strength to "wait one more time." I lack nothing else.

[sine]...go on... 
..I will... be... where you... look back... ..still there.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYA: A splendid room. A dazzling you. But I... am only an old coat that hasn't been claimed yet.
Oh my, even an old coat can become radiant with my blessing.
Are you waiting for a victory that's running late? Come here, let me dress you up to look more like a winner.
Even if you insist on tethering yourself to a moment that will never arrive, you shouldn't look so dusty and disheveled.
...I don't need to look good. I only need "it's not over yet."
How utterly charmless. Take it. Let me watch you keep waiting — wearing my light, and wearing your patience.
You're dancing. I'm waiting. Which of us is a little crazier?
Neither's crazy!! Neither's crazy!! Try this to pass the time!!
Don't rush, don't rush! You mustn't rush! Waiting is... is... a very long lightning bolt!!
Giving you something!! What do you want? A sound that "will still ring tomorrow"!?
...I've put silence in my pocket. Would you like to touch it?
Good! Good! Then it's settled: I'll keep being noisy, and you keep waiting!!
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0-: Your snoring is like the tides... I wait in the tidal waters. I won't drown, I'll only grow quieter.
[thinky_dots]Quiet traveler... take a part of me, and find peace in the tidal waters...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.1-: [thinky_dots]Those awake always want to press on; only those asleep understand lingering... Sleep a while too...[/thinky_dots]
PAEL.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2-: [thinky_dots]Take my flesh and blood... a little flesh and blood that "won't rush you"...[/thinky_dots]
...I'm not afraid of pain. I'm only afraid that pain will drag me away from waiting.
[thinky_dots]Take it... so you can keep lying here... waiting for the road that hasn't come yet...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0-: You want to fight. I want to wait. Can we... each do our own thing?
[b]No!! Take this weapon! Go get stronger!!![/b]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.1-: [b]Your blood has long gone cold! But battle can make even patience boil!![/b]
TANX.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2-: [b]Stop waiting for that person! Fight me — this is your destiny right now!![/b]

If I must fight... wait until I've waited for that person to come. He will strike back in my stead.
[i][font_size=22]Godot takes half a step back, as if yielding the battlefield to the future.[/font_size][/i]
[b]Cowardice!! But you have endless patience!! Take this weapon and go wait![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYA: The fire is warm. But what I'm waiting for isn't warmth — it's "the appointed hour."
It's fine if the hour hasn't come yet. Come on in, let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you up a little while you wait.
Is the only baggage you carry that little bit of [jitter][b]hesitation[/b][/jitter]? Shall I help you burn it away?
My dear, have a taste of the [jitter][b]pastries[/b][/jitter] I made for you. They're the kind that need to cool slowly, and be waited for slowly.
...I'm not hungry. I'm just empty. Empty and hungry feel much alike.
Alright, just have a taste then. And then we'll keep waiting — waiting for the bitterness to [jitter][b]fade away[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.0: Demons make deals too. So what do you want from me? My time? It was never worth much to begin with.
But [sine]time[/sine] of little worth, when accumulated, can become quite considerable...
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.1: I usually sell "immediately" at a steep price. But with you, I want to put a high price tag even on [sine]"later"[/sine].
VAKUU.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_MIYABI.2: If at the bottom of the contract I wrote a line of fine print: permitting you to [sine]wait forever[/sine] — would you sign?
...My name doesn't matter. What matters is that I haven't been called yet.
Take your price. I will never wake you — unless [sine]that moment[/sine] truly arrives.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.MIYABISTS2_CHARACTER_: You stand here, yet it's as if you are nowhere. What are you waiting for? The top of the tower? The ending? Or a word of permission?
Answer
...I'm waiting for a name to be spoken aloud. Until it is, I'm going nowhere.
Continue
Permission? You've never needed it. You're only afraid of "waiting only to have waited for the wrong thing."
You've returned. Time to you is like a corridor — you cannot finish walking it because you do not wish to finish.
Continue
The corridor is good. The end is not. The end means... no more waiting.
Continue
Foolish. If you never walk toward the end, you will forever be nothing but an echo.
Then stand. The tower will remember for you: you have been here, many times, and yet taken nothing away.
Continue
Taking something away... would it make me stop waiting?
Continue
Yes. So don't take anything. Keep waiting — that is the only weapon you are skilled with.
